The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.4821 Of 2020
Order:

-
This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quash of F.I.R in Crime No. 174 of 2020 of Chittoor Taluk Police Station, Chittoor District.

entities.text: Chittoor Taluk Police Station, Chittoor District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3. The petitioners are A-1 and A-3 in Crime No.174 of 2020 registered by the Chittoor Taluk Police.

A case under Sections 188, 270, 273, 328 IPC, Sections 24(1) r/w 27 of the COTP Act, Section 3 of the Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897, Section 4 of the Gutkha Pan Masala Prohibition Act and under Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, was registered against them.
The main allegation is that the petitioners have indulged in illegal transportation of banned tobacco products and other products and thereby committed the aforesaid offences.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that this is a covered matter and earlier this Court has quashed the F.I.R registered against the accused in Crime No.268 of 2020 based on identical facts with similar allegations.
Therefore, he would submit that the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled to the same relief.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would also concede that this Court has earlier quashed the F.I.Rs registered in similar cases on the ground that the prosecution is not maintainable against the accused therein under law.

6. The petitioners have also produced the copy of the order passed in Criminal Petition No.3558 of 2020 before this Court whereby this Court quashed the F.I.R in Crime No.268 of 2020 of Gangavaram Police Station, registered for the same offences based on the earlier orders passed by this Court.
7. Therefore, in view of the earlier orders passed by this Court, the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of F.I.R registered against the petitioners.

1 8.
In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
The F.I.R registered against the petitioners in Crime No. 174 of 2020 of Chittoor Taluk Police Station, is hereby quashed.

JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY Date: 02-11-2020 AKN THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY CRIMINAL PETITION No.4821 OF 2020 Date: 02-11-2020 AKN CRLP/4821/2020 on 2 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72562923/
